timeout-delete: gcloud compute instances create td-vm --zone us-central1-a

timeout-delete.cmd: gcloud compute instances delete td-vm --zone us-central1-a --quiet

failed-line-delete-first: gcloud compute instances create fl-vm --zone us-central1-a

failed-line-delete-first.cmd: gcloud compute instances delete fl-vm --zone us-central1-a --quiet && gcloud compute disks list --bad

create-uncertain.cmd: gcloud container clusters create un-gke --zone us-central1-a

gke-get-cred-noproj: gcloud container clusters create np-gke --zone us-central1-a
gcloud container clusters get-credentials np-gke --zone us-central1-a
region-then-delete-noregion: aws ec2 run-instances --region eu-west-1 --image-id ami-1 --instance-type t3.micro --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=instance,Tags=[{Key=Name,Value=rg-box}]'
gcloud-project-flag-then-delete-noflag: gcloud compute instances create pf-vm --zone us-central1-a --project p1
gcloud compute instances delete pf-vm --zone us-central1-a
az-vm: az vm create -g rg1 -n azvm1 --image Ubuntu2204
fly-machine-run: fly machine run nginx -a acme-app --region sin
gcloud-run-jobs: gcloud run jobs create batch --image gcr.io/p/i --region us-central1
gcloud run jobs execute batch --region us-central1
vertex-endpoint: gcloud ai endpoints create --region us-central1 --display-name ep1
tpu: gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create tpu1 --zone us-central2-b --accelerator-type v4-8 --version tpu-ubuntu2204-base
aws-ecs: aws ecs create-service --cluster c1 --service-name s1 --task-definition t1 --desired-count 2
gcloud-sql-patch: gcloud sql instances patch db1 --tier db-custom-4-16384
project-injection: gcloud compute instances create pj-vm --zone us-central1-a
